representation_fit.evidence: Brief's job is explore×dimensional-space on a dataset with high dimensionality/density and unbounded cardinality. Initial screen (both viewports) is a dedicated OLAP-style explorer: 8-dimension rail (7 categorical + 1 numeric binned to join categoricals, source/data.js:69-72, app.js:38), central projection surface with measure/breakdown aggregation (app.js:288-365), and a 1,280-record inline snapshot with disclosed top-60 cap (app.js:20, data.js:1-3). The discriminating rule '切换维度不重置认知' is architecturally encoded: filters and projection are separate query layers (app.js:23-34, comment app.js:1-8).

primary_task_salience.evidence: At 1280x860 and 1440x900 the widest column is the projection surface ('投影 · 区域' bar chart + 记录 table); the dimension rail and state tray flank it. Exploration grammar is stated directly on-screen: '点名称＝投影 · 勾选值＝过滤' (rail hint), '点击条形＝按该值过滤' (chart hint, index.html:36,59). No competing task dominates the first screen.

time_to_understand.evidence: Header names the product and dataset with 记录 1,280 · 维度 8 · 当前命中 1,280 (1280x860.png header; app.js:224-237); every panel carries an instruction hint (index.html:36,59,64,75,78); the right tray explains the state model ('归属维度 + 来源 · 逐条可回退'). What/where is conveyed on first glance; green '内联就绪，无加载态' pill signals ready state per the delivery constraint.

navigation_cost.evidence: Single screen, zero navigation modes. From initial state: switch projection = 1 click on a dimension name (app.js:495-499); filter = 1 click on rail checkbox (app.js:501-504) or chart bar (app.js:506-509); revert one state = 1 click on tray ✕ (app.js:531-538); undo/redo/reset in the always-visible header (index.html:24-26). Primary object (the dataset projection) is on screen at load.

context_loss.evidence: Structurally context-preserving: makeSetProjection touches only projection and never filters (app.js:113-135); selection persists across projection changes with an explicit warning when a selected record is filtered out (app.js:29,466-470); per-entry revert + undo/redo stacks (app.js:73-168,531-538); cross-filtering excludes the projected dimension's own filters so bars keep context (app.js:61-70); orphaned filters are flagged '不在当前投影 · 仍生效' rather than silently dropped (app.js:430,445).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces = header (3 stats + 3 buttons), rail, projection surface (2 selects + chart + table), tray + inspector — each maps to a required explore function; no decorative chrome. Rail stays compact via collapsed sections with cardinality counts (7 of 8 dims collapsed at load, app.js:32 expanded:{region:true}; visible both screenshots). Density is high but the brief demands high-density/unbounded shape.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails all three a11y checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size (measurement-summary.json:14-16). Corroborating source: 10-10.5px muted text #858b9b on white ≈3.4:1 used for hints/counts (styles.css:7,89,143,162,247-248); 12×12px filter checkboxes (styles.css:138), 20×20px tray ✕ (styles.css:251-254), 20×24px dim expander (styles.css:106-109). Credit for :focus-visible outline (styles.css:36), ARIA roles/labels and aria-live stats (index.html:20,23,33,42,60,72,81), aria-expanded/aria-pressed (app.js:263,345), Enter/Space row activation and Ctrl+Z/Y/Esc (app.js:525-529,566-573) — keeps this above 1.

frontend_rework.evidence: Layout itself is clean — layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass (measurement-summary.json:11-13) and neither screenshot shows overflow, collision, or clipped text. But 4 of 7 checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size; summary 3 pass/4 fail, measurement-summary.json:3-8), each implying rework. Additional visible data defect: revenue clamped at ¥63,000 (data.js:95) makes every visible 收入↓ row render the identical '¥6.3万' in both screenshots, flattening the default sort.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '过滤/投影状态有归属且可回退' is addressed beyond minimum: tray entry shows kind badge + owning dimension + origin (来源：初始默认/维度轨/分布图/明细面板/托盘回退, app.js:94-175,410-454) with per-entry ✕ revert (app.js:531-538); projection revert targets a history stack (app.js:28,113-135,176-179); reset-all is itself undoable (app.js:144-168); tray hover flashes the owning rail row (app.js:539-548). Initial screen already shows the default projection as an attributed, revertible entry ('投影维度→区域 · 来源：初始默认', both screenshots).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast fail: 10-10.5px #858b9b-on-white muted text (~3.4:1) for panel hints, value counts, entry metadata (styles.css:7,89,143; measurement-summary.json checks.a11y.contrast)
a11y.target_size fail: 12×12px filter checkboxes (styles.css:138), 20×20px tray ✕ (styles.css:251-254), 20×24px rail expander (styles.css:106-109)

Revenue clamp Math.min(63000,...) (data.js:95) saturates the top of the distribution: all visible 收入↓ cells show identical '¥6.3万' in both screenshots, so the default sort view carries no discriminative information
Record table hard-capped at first 60 rows with no in-table paging beyond filters (app.js:20,376,406-407) — disclosed in the hint, but unbounded exploration below the cap requires filtering
scores.overall_note: This package implements the dimensional-space explore brief almost exactly: a three-region single-screen explorer (dimension rail / projection surface / state tray + inspector) whose query layer keeps filters and projection orthogonal so dimension switching never resets cognition (app.js:1-8,23-34,113-135), with unusually thorough state attribution — every filter and projection carries a kind, owning dimension and origin, is individually revertible, and sits above undo/redo and an undoable reset. Navigation cost is effectively one click per action and context survives projection switches and filtering, including selection persistence with an explicit exclusion warning. The weaknesses are concentrated in accessibility and polish: the receipt fails a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size and type.min_projected_size (4 of 7 checks, target valid), matching concrete source findings (sub-13px checkboxes and 20px hit targets, ~3.4:1 muted text), and the ¥63,000 revenue clamp visibly flattens the default revenue-sorted table to a wall of identical '¥6.3万' values in both viewports. Layout checks (overflow, responsive collision, truncation) all pass and neither screenshot shows a layout defect. Per the rubric, task completion time, information retrieval accuracy and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot, and the 3-pass/4-fail error tally is referenced as supplied rather than rescored; scores above are model-judged from screenshots, source, and the sanitized receipt, not human preference.
